name: המרת מספר מעורב לשבר מדומה (באנגלית)
questiontext:
Convert the following mixed fraction into an improper (single) fraction:
\[ {{CT:0}}\frac{{CT:1}}{{CT:2}}. \]
[[input:ans]] [[validation:ans]]
generalfeedback: The form \(a\frac{b}{c}\) is really just short for \(a+\frac{b}{c}\). So we're just adding an integer to a fraction. In order to do this we multiply the integer, \(a\), by the denominator, \(c\), and add it to the the numerator of the fraction. This can be seen from the general rule: \[ a\frac{b}{c} = \frac{ac+b}{c}. \] Therefore in this example: \[{{CT:0}}\frac{{CT:1}}{{CT:2}} = \frac{{{CT:0}}\cdot{{CT:2}}+{{CT:1}}}{{CT:2}} = {{CT:3}}. \]
